A FEW CLEAR ANSWERS

Before you
get started.

Explore the practical questions. For the details of your building, talk to Noxy.

Getting startedThe workHandover & warranty

Getting started

What projects are a good fit?

We specialise in larger remedial projects for strata, body corporate, commercial and mixed-use buildings. Typical projects run from $10,000–$100,000+. Small handyman work and one-off patch jobs are outside that focus.

Where do you work?

Brisbane, the Gold Coast and the Sunshine Coast. Share the building suburb when you enquire so access and location can be discussed.

Do we need an existing report?

No. If you already have a report or scope, mention it when you get in touch. If not, discuss the problem with Noxy and arrange the next assessment step.

How do we request an inspection or quote?

Call Noxy directly or use the contact page to prepare an email enquiry. Describe the building, suburb and problem. A written scope is prepared after the cause and requirements have been assessed.

The work

Can you repair a leak without replacing everything?

Sometimes. Investigation comes first. A local repair may be suitable for a localised defect; a failed system may need a broader restoration. The recommendation should follow the evidence.

Will we need to organise separate trades?

We coordinate strip-out, screeding, waterproofing, tiling, caulking and protective coatings through our own crew. The trades included in your job are set out in the agreed scope.

How long will the work take?

Duration depends on the affected area, preparation, access, the proposed system and site conditions. Ask for the expected program and any access restrictions when the written scope is discussed.

Will the project need scaffolding?

Rope access is an option for suitable facade repairs, sealing and coatings. The access method needs to be assessed for the particular building and work.

Handover & warranty

What records will our building receive?

Photo evidence, QA records and a professional handover pack form part of our documented approach. Confirm the documentation included in your written scope.

What warranty applies?

Ask Noxy for the written warranty terms for your project, including the duration, coverage, exclusions and any maintenance responsibilities. The scope and applicable terms should be clear before work proceeds.

Can we review licence and insurance information?

Yes. Ask Noxy for the current licence and insurance documents relevant to the proposed work before proceeding.
